newsitem.title: FRANCE: French shares start higher on the day after audit.
newsitem.headline: French shares start higher on the day after audit.

text.p: French shares opened with a gain on Tuesday morning, the day after the audit of public finances was published and corporate taxation increased, helped by the dollar and Wall Street.
The SBF French Bourses' association said that a slight technical problem had delayed the first calculation of the CAC-40 index while all constituent shares had opened normally.
* CAC-40 index up 27.96, or 0.97 percent, at 2,902.08 at 0812 GMT
* CAC-40 July futures 2,901.5 vs 2,885 at Mondays close.
